leaves.behavior: The 1080p preset accepts system:width = 1,920, system:height = 1,080, closes the owned editor, updates the page and persists recent history. Cancelled, hidden or retired owners cannot change the search or recent history.
limitations: Historical first-pass original preset only; no new implementation credit, parent/alias/native-ID credit or promotion of editable dimension fields.
Qt uses actual Button.click control signals and live recent history; native preset activation dispatches physical pointer events and tests durable store reopening.
Page/recent comparisons establish membership and values, not ordering parity. Cancellation, hidden and retired-owner checks invoke callbacks.
Normal/narrow captures support preset controls only; broader editable-panel layout and its operators/tolerances remain separately assessed.
Linux validation only; Windows and macOS deferred under source policy.

qt-acceptance.description: Nine actual Qt preset Button.click activations through FleshOutPredicates, ordered returned values/live recent history, and rejected modal dialog. Fresh private basic database.

native-interaction.description: Exact-source full Linux GUI tests: all nine physical preset activations, page/recent membership, reopened-store persistence and hidden/cancelled/retired callback guards. Existing editor fixture tests retain ordered model-output coverage.

render-normal.description: Actual 1020x720 dimensions dialog; all nine preset controls.

render-narrow.description: Actual 760x900 dimensions dialog; all nine preset controls.

render-accepted.description: Actual 1020x720 owner after 1080p acceptance; width and height search predicates.
